name: Vampire - Misty Escape - Successes
description: Flavor text for successes a feature

results.text: With a final, gurgling scream, the vampire dissolves into a wisp of nightmarish fog and vanishes into the gloom.
The monster’s body disintegrates in a swirl of ebony mist, slipping through cracks like a shadow given life.
A shriek echoes as the undead vanishes mid-air, leaving only the faint scent of decay in its wake.
Like smoke on the wind, the vampire evaporates into the darkness, leaving no trace behind but dread.
Ink-like tendrils of mist coil around the creature’s fading form before it dissipates entirely.
